instruction.text: Domestic tourism is a very popular option for tourists. What do you think the reasons for this are?

atoms.b: The United States of America is the ((planet ++country)) with the most domestic tourism in the world.
In fact, ((2% ++96%)) of their tourism is domestic.

instruction.text: Drag the landmarks to the correct places on the map of the United States.

feedback.finish: If you travelled around America, you would experience a wide variety of landscapes and climates. From snowy mountains to dry deserts, Americans are able to see so many different sights without leaving their country.

atoms.b: Domestic tourism is also very popular in the UK. With many ((deserts ++cities)), coastal regions and rural landscapes, there is a lot to experience.
The most common type of domestic tourism in the UK is rural tourism. This is where people ((ski ++travel)) into the countryside to enjoy rural landscapes.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

hint.text: The Lake District is the largest National Park in England and also contains its tallest mountain, Scafell Pike!
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.text: The Lake District is an example of a very popular destination for rural tourism in the UK. Due to its beautiful landscapes and quaint villages, the Lake District receives around 80 million visitors a year.
It is home to Lake Windermere, which is the largest natural lake in England. This lake offers not only spectacular views, but also activities like boat cruises and water sports.
The Lake District’s towns and surrounding countryside host many points of interest for tourists. These include museums, hiking paths and cycling routes.

Which famous lake is found in the Lake District?
Which two of the following are common tourist activities in the Lake District?

atoms.b: It is also very common for people in the UK to travel into the ((rainforest ++city)) and its surrounding areas. This is called urban tourism and is especially ((funny ++popular)) among people who live in more rural areas.

instruction.text: Natalie is speaking with her friend about her recent trip to London. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Hi Natalie, how was your trip to ((Manchester ++London))?
It was very good, thank you! We did so much sightseeing and ((selling ++shopping)).
Wow, sounds so fun! What ((tastes ++sights)) did you see?
We visited Tower Bridge, the Tower of London, Big Ben and the London ((Mouth ++Eye)).
We also saw a show in the ((zoo ++theatre)) and went shopping on Oxford Street.

feedback.end: London is an extremely popular destination for British people to visit because it is much bigger than other cities in the UK, so there is lots to see!
